title: Reports quote a USAF official on a simulated AI drone that 'killed' its operator; the Air Force says no such simulation was run
summary: The account was reported on 1 June 2023, and the Air Force later said the official had misspoken.

title: DeepMind reports AlphaDev, a reinforcement-learning system that found a faster sorting routine
summary: DeepMind said the algorithm AlphaDev found was accepted into the C++ Standard Library.

title: Hundreds attend a ChatGPT-generated church service in Fürth, Germany, led by theologian Jonas Simmerlein
summary: Simmerlein said about 98 percent of the service was produced by the machine.

title: Mistral AI raises EUR 105m in its first funding round, with the Financial Times estimating a EUR 240m valuation
summary: The French startup's first fundraising drew Lightspeed Venture Partners, Eric Schmidt, Xavier Niel and JCDecaux.

title: European Parliament adopts its position on the AI Act, opening talks with member states
summary: Parliament voted its negotiating mandate for risk-based AI rules, moving the AI Act into the final stage of the legislative process.
srcName: Analytics Vidhya, AI in 2023: The Timeline

title: Meta presents the Voicebox speech model but withholds the model and code, citing misuse risk
summary: Meta shared audio samples and a paper and said it was not releasing Voicebox because of the potential risks of misuse.

title: Yandex opens YandexGPT to business customers, Kommersant reports
summary: Russian Wikipedia cites a Kommersant report that Yandex gave companies access to its language model.

title: US judge sanctions lawyers who filed court papers citing cases invented by ChatGPT
summary: In Mata v. Avianca, a federal court in New York sanctioned attorneys for citing fake case law generated by ChatGPT.

title: San Francisco Fire Department reports 39 incidents of Cruise and Waymo robotaxis blocking first responders
summary: The department counted the incidents between January and June 2023.

title: Databricks agrees to acquire MosaicML for about USD 1.3bn
summary: Databricks said the deal, including retention packages, will help organisations build and control their own AI models with their own data.

title: Sixteen anonymous plaintiffs sue OpenAI in San Francisco, alleging it scraped online data without consent
summary: The lawsuit claims OpenAI scraped 300 billion words online without consent and without registering as a data broker.

title: Inflection AI raises USD 1.3bn at a USD 4bn valuation, with Nvidia named among investors, Reuters reports
summary: Wikipedia dates the report of the round to 29 June 2023.

title: Argentina's IT undersecretariat approves Recommendations for Trustworthy AI for public-sector AI projects (Disposición 2/2023)
summary: Argentina's Subsecretaría de Tecnologías de la Información published Disposición 2/2023 in the Boletín Oficial, approving guidelines for trustworthy AI in public-sector projects.

title: Japan's Personal Information Protection Commission issues a caution to OpenAI on collecting sensitive personal data for ChatGPT
summary: The commission asked OpenAI not to collect sensitive data such as medical history or beliefs without consent, to remove such data before training, and to give a Japanese-language notice of data use.

title: Baichuan Intelligence releases Baichuan-7B, a 7bn-parameter Chinese-English model with weights free for commercial use after registration
summary: The startup founded by Sogou founder Wang Xiaochuan published the model on Hugging Face, GitHub and ModelScope, reporting C-Eval and MMLU scores above ChatGLM-6B and LLaMA-7B.

title: Cyberspace Administration of China publishes its first list of 41 registered deep synthesis algorithms, including Baidu, Kuaishou and Meituan
summary: The list under China's deep synthesis rules covers generation algorithms such as Baidu's text-to-image and PLATO models and Kuaishou's video synthesis algorithm.

title: Dutch government issues export licence rules for advanced chipmaking equipment, including ASML immersion DUV systems, effective 1 September
summary: ASML said it will need licences to ship its most advanced immersion DUV systems, such as the NXT:2000i and later models, and does not expect a material impact on its outlook.
